title: Editor Browser Live Backend Smoke
summary: Completed the bounded Editor browser-app smoke: a real headless Chrome session opens the rendered product routes against a live loopback Backend server, loads the Core-backed document, applies migration through the UI, commits one UI reorder mutation, and retains the observed Backend request/status evidence.
expectedOutput: An Editor-owned browser smoke test or a boundary blocker that distinguishes the rendered browser app plus live Backend/Core path from the accepted Node loopback harness, followed by Project Control evidence registration without broad map promotion.
riskSummary: The smoke proves only a local loopback headless Chrome product-route path over one seeded Core fixture and one UI reorder mutation. It does not prove deployed Backend readiness, cross-browser behavior, broad document-corpus coverage, accessibility, visual regression, npm audit remediation, or bundle-splitting readiness.
